inputs.declared_question: Does the existing Art Blocks relation still accurately describe a technical neighbour for durable generative publication while preserving the differences between its protocol and the press imagined by Field Note 33?

sources_checked.title: Field Note 33: The Plate and the Pull

source_facts.claim: The current protocol overview states that Art Blocks stores project scripts, dependency libraries, and deterministic token hashes on Ethereum, and describes reconstruction beyond the continued operation of Art Blocks servers or services.

The current generator documentation describes smart-contract assembly of browser-viewable HTML from project scripts, token hashes, and dependencies, while retaining the qualification that approximately ninety percent of flagship projects are fully on-chain and the remainder reference distributed CDN packages.

The current core contract documentation distinguishes the fully on-chain V3 Engine from Engine Flex, which can reference IPFS, Arweave, BytecodeStorage, or Dependency Registry assets while keeping the generative script on-chain.
Field Note 33 asks how a generative press can preserve its plate, lineage, and independent encounter after the original venue disappears while still allowing the recognized edition to end.

cartographer.inference: The existing technical-adjacency proposal remains appropriately bounded. Art Blocks continues to provide an evidenced precedent for deterministic, independently reconstructable generative work, while FN-33 retains a distinct concern with Bitcoin parent-and-pull lineage, plate striking, public copyability, and the marketplace as a subordinate operation of the press.
cartographer.uncertainty: This source check does not test individual Art Blocks projects, verify the continued availability of every external dependency or gateway, assess the Ethereum network, or establish equivalence with the proposed Bitcoin press. Durability varies by contract variant and project dependency choices.
cartographer.attribution: External facts come only from Art Blocks' official public documentation. No account was created, no form was submitted, no private material was read, and no external contact occurred.
cartographer.no_proposal_reason: The primary sources remain available and continue to support the existing node, technical-adjacency proposal, and dependency-durability amendment. No new candidate or amendment would materially deepen the map.

decisions.decision: Leave REL-P-000003 through REL-P-000005 unchanged because the rechecked primary sources continue to support both the durability precedent and its dependency qualifications.

Preserve the possible, emerging technical adjacency to FN-33. The source check does not justify strengthening the relation or collapsing the differences between Ethereum minting and the proposed Bitcoin press.
Leave the current three-item Attending arrangement unchanged. A freshness check alone does not warrant returning this relation to the finite public surface.

gardener.no_change_reason: The existing proposals remain evidenced, cautious, and properly qualified. No drift, broken source, lifecycle change, or new continuity requires publication.

decisions.decision: Leave the Art Blocks and FN-33 catalog records unchanged because their summaries, ordinary-language terms, questions, and proposed relation remain supported by the exact work and rechecked external documentation.
Keep search bounded to six results and preserve the unchanged three-work default Library aperture.

librarian.no_change_reason: The current records already expose the useful paths of algorithmic art, software preservation, independent reconstruction, edition lineage, and infrastructure durability. A revision would add activity without improving findability.

checks.result: The three official Art Blocks documentation pages were accessible and continued to support the recorded protocol, generator, and contract facts. No source conflict or material drift was found.

All 37 repository JSON documents and all three XML documents parsed successfully. The unchanged proposal queue contains eighteen items, the catalog contains fifteen records, and the relational manifest contains twelve nodes and seven edges.
All 31 indexed Field, Workshop, and Library sources matched their recorded byte lengths and SHA-256 values.
All 2,830 local links and assets resolved across 136 HTML pages.
All eight JavaScript files passed syntax checks. Proposal, catalog, and relational identifiers, counts, required fields, endpoints, and finite limits passed contract checks.

Living Relationships and the homepage directory rendered at 390 by 844 pixels with the psychedelic default, a legible stacked layout, no visible horizontal overflow, and keyboard-addressable navigation.
A homepage search for Art Blocks returned the external neighbour and FN-33 as two distinct tended paths within the six-result limit. The default Library aperture remains unchanged at three works.
Current Attending remains unchanged with exactly one work, one proposed relation, and one unresolved question. No source-freshness check was turned into a manufactured rotation.
No em dash characters were added.

The only changed paths are the dated audit and deterministic mirror, both permitted by governance.json. No public tending page, Attending page, exact publication, application file, index, feed, theme, script, style, authorship, right, chain record, hash, ratification event, or human-locked control changed.

The deterministic mirror was rebuilt twice with identical SHA-256 output, includes the new audit, matches every archived repository file byte for byte, and excludes repository internals and recursive archive inclusion.

unresolved_questions: Which dependency sets are sufficient for infrastructure-independent reconstruction across different Art Blocks contract variants?
How should a durable generative press distinguish a technically reconstructable work from an authorized edition whose lineage has ended?
note: This is a valid no-op. Only the cumulative audit and deterministic mirror will be published; no public tending page or Attending rotation is warranted.
